bundles.description: Source, protocol, schema, template, hook, and test paths that may form a narrow commit bundle.
Generated carrier projections, branch-capsule records, and sanitized local-PC evidence.
Deleted paths require explicit archive/cleanup intent and should not ride with carrier infrastructure commits.
Runtime state, bridge residues, response runs, private raw context, and local-only transient material.
Path names suggest credentials, tokens, browser profiles, tunnel material, or private logs.
Untracked files that are not clearly excluded or source-classified need owner classification.
Changed paths outside recognized owner surfaces; classify with the operator before staging.

recommended_commit_order: deletion_review_required only with separate cleanup packet
candidate_stage_manifest.rule: This is a proposal only. It does not run git add, git commit, git push, or settlement.

non_claims: This audit does not stage, commit, push, or accept state.
This audit classifies path-level Git changes; it does not read raw Codex memories or secrets.
Stage manifests are proposals until operator/Steward settlement.
Generated local-PC evidence remains candidate until proof-gated and receipted.
proof_obligations: secret/path review for excluded and generated evidence bundles
separate packet for deletion/archive cleanup paths
